He currently plays for [[BC Triumph Lyubertsy|Triumph Lyubertsy]].{{cite web |url=http://nbadraft.net/players/sergey-karasev |title=NBA Draft |work=nbadraft.net |accessdate=July 22, 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://insider.espn.go.com/nba/draft/results/players?id=19785&_slug_=sergey-karasev&action=login&appRedirect=http%3a%2f%2finsider.espn.go.com%2fnba%2fdraft%2fresults%2fplayers%3fid%3d19785%26_slug_%3dsergey-karasev |title=ESPN DraftTracker |work=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=July 22, 2012}} ==Professional career== With the [[VTB United League]] club [[BC Triumph Lyubertsy|Triumph Lyubertsy]], Karasev averaged 16.1 points per game during the [[Eurocup 2012-13|2012-13 season]] of the [[European professional club basketball system|2nd-tier European league]], the [[Eurocup Basketball|Eurocup]].[http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=004302&clubcode=DYR&seasoncode=U2012 EurocupBasketball.com KARASEV, SERGEY 2012-2013 STATISTICS.] On April 3, 2013, Karasev decided to declare for the [[2013 NBA Draft]]. He is currently projected to be a late first round or early second round pick. ==Russian national team== Karasev played with the junior national teams of Russia. He played at the [[2009 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]]. He also won the silver medal at the [[2010 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], and the bronze medal at the [[2011 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]]. He was named to the senior men's [[Russia national basketball team]] roster for the [[Basketball at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men|2012 Summer Olympic Games]] in [[London]].{{cite web|url=http://london2012.fiba.com/pages/eng/fe/12/olym/team/p/eid/6232/lid//rid//sid/6232/tid/381/profile.html|title=RUS -
